_about: Public-domain Howard Allen Bridgman (1860-1929), Congregational minister and editor of The Congregationalist, for the Word Hoard: Steps Christward (counsels for young Christians), Real Religion, and New England in the Life of the World. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 115 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

bridgman-steps-christward: Steps Christward; counsels for young Christians (Boston, Chicago, The Pilgrim press, 1903)
bridgman-real-religion: Real religion; friendly talks to the average man on clean and useful living (Boston, New York, Pilgrim Press, 1910)
bridgman-new-england: New England in the life of the world; a record of adventure and achievement (Boston, Chicago, The Pilgrim Press, 1910)
